options.description: The items, in the order they are shown.
options.name: items

options.description: Draw the pointer and the marks with ASCII only, `>` and `[x]`. Defaults to what `unicodeSupported()` says, which is the rule `Tabs` keeps.
options.name: ascii

options.description: The current row, as its key, or the state that holds it: see `ListSelectionOptions.current`.
options.name: current

options.description: Whether an item's row is disabled: drawn muted, passed over by the cursor, not clicked, and never selected by a key or a click.
options.name: disabled

options.description: What to show when there are no items. A string is drawn muted; a function builds an element. Defaults to "Nothing to show".
options.name: empty

options.description: Type-to-find: a printable key moves the cursor to the next row whose `label` starts with what was typed in the last second. Off by default, because a list that takes every letter takes the app's own keys -- `q` among them -- while it has the focus. Not with `vim`, which wants four of those letters.
options.name: find

options.description: What identifies an item's row, which the cursor and the selection hold. Defaults to the item itself, which is right for strings and for objects that are never replaced; data that is fetched again wants its own id here.
options.name: key

options.description: The text type-to-find matches against. Defaults to the item itself for a string or a number, and nothing -- a row `find` never lands on -- otherwise.
options.default: the item itself for a string or a number
options.name: label

options.description: Whether more than one row can be selected. Space selects the current row, Ctrl-A every row, and a click the row clicked; each selected row carries a mark. Defaults to `false`, where the current row is the selection.
options.name: multiple

options.description: Called with the current row's key and item on Enter or a double-click. A list without one claims neither, so Enter reaches whatever is around it.
options.name: onActivate

options.description: The host box's own props: a height, a border, a class.
options.name: props

options.description: Builds an item's row: an element, or a string drawn as one line.
options.name: row

options.description: Every row's height in cells, fixed rather than measured. Defaults to 1.
options.name: rowHeight

options.description: Whether to draw a scrollbar. Defaults to `true`.
options.name: scrollbar

options.description: The selected rows, as keys, or the state that holds them: see `ListSelectionOptions.selected`.
options.name: selected

options.description: `j` and `k` to move, and `g` and `G` to the ends, which is `less`'s spelling and the pager's. Off by default for the reason `find` is.
options.name: vim
